eventMetadata.context_description: Recent Met Office forecast data show a stable high-pressure system over southern England today, with light winds and variable cloud cover limiting daytime heating and anchoring the market-implied odds near 19–20 °C for London’s maximum temperature. Ensemble model runs display tight clustering around these values, consistent with typical mid-May climatology when Atlantic influences remain weak. Minor differences in predicted insolation or boundary-layer mixing could still tip the official reading—measured at standard stations—to 21 °C or hold it at 19 °C, underscoring the narrow uncertainty range that keeps the two leading outcomes closely matched ahead of the day’s final observations.
